Theme

Time, the calendar & feasts

past noun

time gone by

also the past, bygones

classical

Caes. BG 1.20: praeterita sē frātrī condōnāre dīcit (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Pis. 59: praeterita mūtāre nōn possumus (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 357

praeterita, praeteritōrum n. pl.

noun, second declension, plural

the past, what is past

The neuter plural of the participle of praetereō, “things gone by”; “in the past” is anteā, antehāc.

See also previously, history.

SourcesLewis & Short: praetereo
